Home · About Us

A café that gets student life

We're not trying to be a fancy coffee house. We're the friendly, budget-conscious spot at the heart of campus — built around how students actually live, study and socialise.

Our story

Born between the bookshelves

Café Library sits on the ground floor of Warwick Library — a popular spot for fuelling up between study sessions. We noticed something simple: the best part of a long library day is often the coffee break. So we built everything around that moment.

Whether you want to grab a quick coffee on the way to a lecture, or take a break with friends over something more filling, there's space for you here — inside, or out at The Forum when the sun makes an appearance.

Our team knows the regulars by their order. Our prices know a student budget. And our kitchen keeps things fresh, local and honest.

Home · Sustainability

Sustainability you can taste

We believe a campus café should look after the campus. Here's exactly what we're doing to reduce our environmental impact — and how we look after what's on your plate.

♻️

Zero single-use plastic

We've removed all single-use plastic cutlery, cups and bottles from our outlets. Everything we hand you is reusable or responsibly sourced.

☕

25p reusable cup reward

We incentivise our customers to use a reusable cup for takeaway drinks, rewarding them with a 25p discount every time.

🚜

Local, first

We source ingredients from as close to campus as possible — from University land, local and regional producers, and from across the UK.

Where your food comes from

Short journeys, fresher food

Food miles matter — to flavour, to freshness and to footprint. That's why our supply chain starts on our own campus, then widens out to Warwickshire producers and UK suppliers before we look anywhere else.

It also means our menu can change with the seasons — keep an eye on the weekly specials board for dishes built around what's available locally.

Allergen guidance

We provide clear allergen guidance, and our trained team can talk you through ingredients for any dish when you visit.

Please speak to us about allergies. If you have any food allergies or dietary requirements, please speak to a member of our team when visiting our café. We can't guarantee our busy kitchen is totally allergen free — but we'll always do our best to help you choose safely.

Before you visit

Quick answers

Can I study in the café?

Absolutely — that's what we're here for. Take a seat inside, or head out to The Forum just outside when you fancy fresh air with your flashcards.

Do you have vegan options?

Yes, every day. Look for the VG label on the menu — the dahl & chapati (£2.99) and coronation chickpea jacket potato are student favourites, and we offer plant milks for coffee.

How does the reusable cup discount work?

Simple: bring any reusable cup, and we take 25p off your takeaway hot drink. Good for your wallet, better for the planet.

Is the café cashless?

Yes — we're cashless, so tap your card, phone or watch and go.

I have a food allergy. Can I eat here?

Please speak to a member of our team — we provide clear allergen guidance and our staff are trained to help. We can't guarantee our busy kitchen is totally allergen free, but we'll always help you choose with confidence.
